verdict.rationale: Terraform's own CLI provides the core mechanism. State maps real-world resources to configuration (terraform-docs-20), `terraform plan` previews the changes needed to reconcile them (terraform-docs-15), and `-refresh-only` plans updates to state from the actual infrastructure (terraform-docs-45). Plan output can also be emitted as JSON for automated checks (terraform-docs-48, terraform-docs-22). However, the evidence never explicitly frames any of this as drift detection, and no dedicated or continuous drift-detection feature is documented. missing for 10: explicit drift-detection documentation, scheduled/continuous drift monitoring or alerting, hands-on corroboration of drift-detection use.
